decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's secure communication platform that remained actively marketed through 2024, it likely meets at least modest aspiration levels and a large incumbent has enough slack to keep developing it.

Although newly launched in 2024 and therefore still uncertain, it fits the core email and messaging offer well, so management would usually keep it unless early results clearly fall below aspiration levels.

This product is also new and may face somewhat narrower demand than other messaging modules, but its strong relatedness to the established platform and the firm's broad solution strategy make retention more likely than withdrawal.
